title.ko: 법률 영어: hereinafter · notwithstanding · shall · party · indemnify · force majeure · governing law
title.en: legal English: hereinafter, notwithstanding, shall, party, indemnify, force majeure, governing law

explain.ko: 법률 영어는 정확성과 모호함의 회피를 최우선으로 합니다. shall은 의무(The Seller shall deliver ...), may는 권리를 나타내며, hereinafter(이하), notwithstanding(~에도 불구하고) 같은 전통적 어휘를 씁니다. 계약서는 정의 조항, 의무, 면책(indemnify), 불가항력(force majeure), 해지(terminate), 준거법(governing law) 순으로 구성되는 경우가 많습니다. 법적 효력이 있으므로 서명 전에 전문가의 검토를 받는 것이 좋습니다.
explain.en: Legal English gives first priority to precision and avoidance of ambiguity. Shall expresses obligation (The Seller shall deliver ...) and may expresses right, and traditional vocabulary such as hereinafter and notwithstanding is used. Contracts are often organised in the order of definitions, obligations, indemnity, force majeure, termination and governing law. Since they have legal effect, it is advisable to have an expert review them before signing.

items.passage:
LEGAL GUIDE
How to read a contract
A contract starts with definition clauses and continues with obligations, rights, indemnity, termination and governing law. Shall expresses obligation and may expresses right. Ambiguous wording can cause disputes, so always check it before signing.
